author.name: Alex Chen
author.bio: Alex Chen is a senior AI tools reviewer with 8+ years of experience testing and evaluating artificial intelligence software. Alex holds a Master's degree in Computer Science from Stanford University and previously worked as a machine learning engineer at Google.

If you can only subscribe to one AI tool, ChatGPT is still the safest choice.
